tldr: Uranus in Gemini: change arrives through language, learning, and how information moves.
body: With Uranus in Gemini, the urge to break from old patterns works through words, ideas, media, and daily connections. Conversations, news, and ways of learning become the places where the familiar gets disrupted. (Modern planet; no traditional dignity.)
gift: Fresh thinking, quick invention, and the nerve to say what nobody else is saying.
challenge: Restlessness, scattered attention, and changing the subject instead of finishing the thought.
note: Composed (planet x sign, dignity-aware); refine from authored material.
